content.title: About
content.content: French or Catalina Light Dressing is a flavorful sauce made from vegetable oils, vinegar, spices, and a touch of sugar. It is intended for dressing salads, vegetable dishes, and seafood, giving them a light sweet‑tart note without excess calories.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The blend combines classic French herbs with the mild sweetness typical of Catalina dressing.
The light version contains less fat and fewer calories than traditional dressings, thanks to reduced‑fat oil and vinegar.
Common ingredients include Dijon mustard, lemon juice, and aromatic herbs such as basil, oregano, and parsley.
It fits well into low‑carb and weight‑management diets.

items.title: Low calorie content
items.content: Provides flavor without significantly increasing the energy value of a dish.

items.title: Source of plant oils
items.content: Olive and sunflower oils supply monounsaturated fats that are heart‑friendly.

items.title: Vitamins and antioxidants
items.content: Herbs and spices (basil, oregano) contain vitamin K, vitamin C, and polyphenols that help protect cells.

items.title: Supports digestion
items.content: Vinegar and lemon juice stimulate gastric juice production, aiding nutrient absorption.

items.title: Low sugar
items.content: Minimal added sugar makes it suitable for people monitoring blood glucose.

items.title: Allergy to ingredients
items.content: May contain mustard, egg, or dairy components—check the label if you have allergies.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Some formulations have higher salt levels; individuals with hypertension should watch portion size.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: Vinegar and lemon can irritate the stomach lining in people with gastritis or ulcers.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Drizzle over ready salads, raw vegetables, boiled chicken, or seafood. It can also be mixed into marinades for grilling or used as a sandwich spread.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep refrigerated after opening in a tightly sealed container. Once opened, it is usually good for 4–6 weeks. Discard if the smell or taste changes.
